parameters.jsCode:
// Get the first incoming item
const input = items[0].json;

// Flatten each item in the items array
const flattened = input.items.map(item => ({
  orderId: input.orderId,
  uniqueOrderRecordId: input.uniqueOrderRecordId,
  dateOrdered: input.dateOrdered,
  totalItems: input.totalItems,
  totalQuantity: input.totalQuantity,
  orderedBy: input.orderedBy,
  deliveryParty: input.deliveryParty,
  contractorCompany: input.contractorCompany,
  region: input.region,
  technician: input.technician,
  onBehalfOf: input.onBehalfOf,
  orderLocation: input.orderLocation,
  recipientName: input.recipientName,
  recipientCompanyName: input.recipientCompanyName,
  recipientAddress: input.recipientAddress,
  recipientContactNumber: input.recipientContactNumber,
  recipientEmail: input.recipientEmail,
  cellPhoneNumber: input.cellPhoneNumber,
  warehouseFulfilling: input.warehouseFulfilling,
  deliverToParty: input.deliverToParty,

  // Item-level fields
  deviceType: item.deviceType,
  quantityOrdered: item.quantityOrdered,
  itemUrl: item.itemUrl,
  itemCode: item.itemCode,

  // Metadata fields
  dispatchMethod: input.metadata?.dispatchMethod,
  waybillNumber: input.metadata?.waybillNumber,
  dispatchStatus: input.metadata?.dispatchStatus,
  pickStatus: input.metadata?.pickStatus,
  additionalNotes: input.metadata?.additionalNotes
}));

// Return multiple items (n8n will treat each as a separate record)
return flattened.map(f => ({ json: f }));
